description: Public-health executive overview with activity, coverage, demographics and disease surveillance. Aggregate data only.

options.content:
# Public health · Executive overview
District coverage, diagnosis activity and patient composition in one place. **Use the filters above to explore.**

panels.title: Diagnosis records
panels.description: Within the selected period and filters. Encounters are distinct recorded encounter identifiers; diagnosis records are not visit counts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring})

options.content:
### Activity & change
Daily volumes and the change from the preceding equal-length period.

panels.title: Daily activity
panels.description: Zero-filled days. Daily unique patients must not be summed to obtain period unique patients.

targets.rawSql: WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp), date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp), interval '1 day') AS time), counts AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',created_date) AS time, COUNT(*)::float AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT uhid_number)::float AS patients FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1) SELECT days.time, COALESCE(records,0) AS "Diagnosis records", COALESCE(patients,0) AS "Daily unique patients" FROM days LEFT JOIN counts USING(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Records · period change
panels.description: Compared with the preceding interval of equal duration. All filters also apply to the baseline; calendar filters may exclude it. No baseline is shown when the previous count is zero.

targets.rawSql: WITH c AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date))::float AS current, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - ($__timeTo()::timestamp - $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND created_date < $__timeFrom()::timestamp)::float AS previous FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring}) AND created_date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - ($__timeTo()::timestamp - $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND created_date <= $__timeTo()::timestamp) SELECT 100.0*(current-previous)/NULLIF(previous,0) AS value FROM c

panels.title: Latest record in selection
panels.description: Latest source record, not the browser refresh time. Source timestamp has no timezone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(MAX(created_date),'DD Mon YYYY HH24:MI') AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring})

options.content:
### Where activity is concentrated
Rankings reflect recorded diagnosis volume, not population-adjusted disease rates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(district_name,''),'Unknown') AS label, COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Records" FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1 LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(diagnosis_desc,''),'Unknown') AS label, COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Records" FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1 LIMIT 10

options.content:
### Patient & service composition
Demographics show diagnosis-record distribution; a patient can contribute multiple records.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(gender_name,''),'Unknown') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Age · record distribution
panels.description: Numeric ageyear values only; invalid or implausible values appear as Unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN btrim(ageyear) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CASE WHEN btrim(ageyear)::numeric < 18 THEN '0–17' WHEN btrim(ageyear)::numeric < 35 THEN '18–34' WHEN btrim(ageyear)::numeric < 60 THEN '35–59' WHEN btrim(ageyear)::numeric <= 120 THEN '60+' ELSE 'Unknown' END ELSE 'Unknown' END AS label,COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(speciality_name,''),'Unknown') AS label,COUNT(*) AS value FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

options.content:
### Disease surveillance
Category flags can overlap. Counts across categories should not be added together.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT * FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring})) SELECT 'Communicable' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_communicable='Y') AS value FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 'Non-communicable' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_non_communicable='Y') AS value FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 'Notifiable' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_notifiable='Y') AS value FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 'Vector-borne' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vector_borne='Y') AS value FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT 'Occupational' AS label,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_occupational_notifiable='Y') AS value FROM selected

SELECT date_trunc('day',created_date) AS time,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_communicable='Y')::float AS "Communicable", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_non_communicable='Y')::float AS "Non-communicable", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_notifiable='Y')::float AS "Notifiable", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vector_borne='Y')::float AS "Vector-borne", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_occupational_notifiable='Y')::float AS "Occupational" FROM public.diagnosis_dashboard_data WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date) AND (${district:sqlstring} = 'All' OR district_name = ${district:sqlstring}) AND (${unit:sqlstring} = 'All' OR unit_name = ${unit:sqlstring}) AND (${year:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY') = ${year:sqlstring}) AND (${month:sqlstring} = 'All' OR to_char(created_date, 'YYYY-MM') = ${month:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

options.content:
### Coverage notes
Missing fields can affect rankings and demographic interpretation. Auto-refresh: **5 minutes**.
